fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) fell 36.8% from the September high as of November 12, declining 26.8% over the past month, significantly exceeding S&P 500's 1.6% decline.
fields.summary_ko.1: Dell's 12-month cumulative revenue (as of July 31, 2026) reached $151.0 billion (YoY +49.0%), with operating margin rising to 9.6% from 7.1% year-over-year, though gross margin declined to 19.8%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Infrastructure Solutions Group achieved rapid growth with $60.8 billion in revenue (YoY +39.5%), but supply shortages (particularly DRAM and NAND) and worsening PC segment profitability emerged as concerns.
